requirements.about: Minimum tool versions, so the front desk skips a route whose tool is too old instead of failing (Haiku 5.5 needs Claude Code 2.1.293; Sonnet 5.5 needs 2.1.284; Opus 5.5 needs 2.1.280).

rules.about: Standing rules about what an engineer may be used for, beyond the commission register. Entries are appended, never edited. 'mode' is review (read-only analysis and review) or implement (work that writes).

modeExclusions.reason: Cursor Auto picks the model itself, so what would review the work is unknown. It may still implement.
